templates.name: Standard policy
templates.description: A clear foundation for department policies.
templates.body:
Purpose
Describe why this policy is required.

Scope
Identify the people, systems and activities covered.

Policy requirements
Set out mandatory controls and procedures.

Responsibilities
Identify accountable roles.

Exceptions
Explain how exceptions are requested and reviewed.

Related guidance
List relevant regulations and supporting policies.

templates.name: Information security
templates.body:
Purpose
Protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of bank information.

Scope
Define covered information, systems and staff.

Policy requirements
Describe access controls, handling requirements and incident reporting.

Responsibilities
Assign control owners and oversight.

Exceptions
Define approval and expiry requirements.

Related guidance
Identify applicable safeguards and supporting procedures.

templates.name: Operating procedure
templates.body:
Purpose
Describe the intended outcome.

Scope
Define when this procedure applies.

Policy requirements
1. Record the request.
2. Verify required approvals.
3. Complete and document the activity.

Responsibilities
Identify who performs and oversees each step.

Exceptions
Describe escalation when requirements cannot be met.

Related guidance
List supporting policies and records.
